correctness.rationale: The sampling point is a plant-change boundary, with the backward donor runs iid by assumption. Setting Y=q^L, block summation of the normalized geometric flower masses gives W_i=(1−Y_i)∏_{j<i}Y_j, whose total telescopes to 1 as every Y_i≤q<1. Conditional independence of the seeds makes the match probability ∑ W_i² for one realized history. Independence of runs and summation of nonnegative series give the displayed means and H=(1−2μ+ν)/(1−ν); taking the square after expectation instead yields the pooled value. Subtraction gives the stated positive multiple of ν−μ², zero exactly for deterministic L; the same argument works at each positive integer higher moment order. For fixed (q,μ) with μ<q, choose a=q^k,b=q^(k+1) bracketing μ. The expectation of (Y−a)(Y−b) is nonnegative on the entire lattice with zeros only at a,b; the mean fixes their weights uniquely, including the deterministic endpoint. Y²≤qY is strict away from Y=q since Y=0 is unavailable; hence ν<qμ. A two-point law on {q,q^N} of mean μ tends to ν=qμ, and mixing such length laws with the minimizer at fixed mean realizes every intermediate ν, drawing each run independently from the mixed law. The strict derivative of F_μ transfers the interval to H. When μ=q there is only L=1. For geometric departure, α=ρ/(ρ+τq) and direct summation gives 1−ν=(1−q²)/(1−(1−τ)q²); then H=2α/(1−ν)−1=(2α−ρ)/(2−ρ). At fixed 0<α<1, 0<τ<1 is equivalent to 0<ρ<α; the displayed rational inversion and open wedge follow from strict decrease of H. As a check, (q,μ)=(1/2,1/3) gives ν_−=1/8, H_−=11/21 and H_+=3/5 (unattained), and ρ=τ=1/2 gives H=5/9.
residual_risks: Exact conditional-iid single-probe model with distinct donor plants and no sampling/weighting by realized fertility or other history-dependent recipient selection. No reliance on finite simulations or claim of field validity.

value.rationale: The exact interval answers what within-fruit full-sib risk is still compatible with a fixed carryover rate and an entire averaged profile, which otherwise conceals itinerary variation. It distinguishes the role of the integer residence constraint from near-extreme rare/long runs. The geometric calibration shows precisely which additional population statistic separates two mechanistically different rates, with sharp feasibility boundaries. This is useful as an idealized modeling and calibration benchmark, not a claim of field inference from one fruit.
residual_risks: The calibration requires known last-donor rank and a population estimate of the correct within-probe match probability; repeat plant visits, selfing, variable deposition or selection can change both statistics and the bounds.
